scope: One 52m x 1m pile with assumed linear springs, damping and nodal cap load. Not the 947-pile foundation, no coupled tower load, no as-built settlement/capacity prediction.
signConvention: axialTensionPositive_N: negative compression; sideReactionOnPile_N uses global signs; moment/shear each array stores [head-end,toe-end] internal section values
coordinateSystem: Global X horizontal, Y upward, Z out of plane; pile head local=(0,0,0); local beam X down, local Y global+X. All arrays retain physical magnitude.

fieldInterpretation.soilForceOnPile_N: Actual fine-mesh spring+dashpot forces, grouped to the nearest displayed node. Applies to THIS independent pile only.
fieldInterpretation.soilEquivalentCouple_Nm: Compensating couple from aggregation; combine with soilForceOnPile_N for exact global moment balance.
fieldInterpretation.shaftBinAverageTraction_Pa: Interface vertical force / circumferential tributary area; not volumetric soil stress.
fieldInterpretation.segmentNormalStressEnvelope_MPa: max(|N|/A+|M|D/(2I)) of all fine elements in each display segment. Nonnegative normal-stress envelope in the elastic pile.
